items.name: Push-ups
items.instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor, then press back up. Keep your hips from sagging.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Backpack Rows
items.instructions: Hold a loaded backpack by the straps. Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, then pull the bag towards your lower ribs and lower it slowly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Pike Push-ups
items.instructions: Start in a downward-dog shape with hips high. Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor, then press back up.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Reverse Flys
items.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, light weight in each hand (water bottles work). Raise both arms out to the sides with soft elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades, lower slowly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Plank
items.instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your abs and glutes and breathe steadily.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Squats
items.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart. Sit your hips back and down as if onto a chair, keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then stand tall.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlifts
items.instructions: Hold a loaded backpack in front of your thighs. With soft knees, push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Reverse Lunges
items.instructions: Step one leg back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, then push through the front heel to return. Count reps for ONE leg; the app counts both sides.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, and lower.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Dead Bugs
items.instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips. Lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor while keeping your lower back pressed down, then switch. Count reps for ONE side.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Biceps Curls
items.instructions: Stand tall with a weight in each hand, elbows by your sides. Curl up without swinging, squeeze at the top, and lower under control.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Overhead Triceps Extensions
items.instructions: Hold one weight with both hands overhead. Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, keeping your upper arms still, then extend back up.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Hamstring Walkouts
items.instructions: Lie on your back in a glute bridge. Walk your heels out slowly while keeping your hips lifted, then walk them back in.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Calf Raises
items.instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed. Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, and lower slowly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Wall Sit
items.instructions: Back flat on a wall, slide down until your knees are about 90 degrees over your ankles. Hold, breathing steadily.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Running
items.instructions: Run at a pace where you can still speak in short sentences. Land softly under your hips and keep your shoulders relaxed. Brisk walking is the alternative.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Brisk Walking
items.instructions: Walk fast enough that your breathing is quicker but you can still talk. Swing your arms and keep an upright posture.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Suryanamaskar
items.instructions: Flow through the twelve-pose sequence with the breath: prayer, raised arms, forward fold, lunge, plank, eight-limb pose, cobra, downward dog, lunge, forward fold, raised arms, prayer. One full sequence is one round.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Cat-Cow Flow
items.instructions: On hands and knees, inhale to drop your belly and lift your chest (cow), exhale to round your spine and tuck your chin (cat). Each switch is one transition.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.instructions: Kneel, sit your hips back towards your heels and fold forward with your arms extended or by your sides. Rest your forehead down and breathe slowly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Knee Push-ups
items.instructions: Same as a push-up but with your knees on the floor. Keep a straight line from head to knees.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Incline Push-ups
items.instructions: Hands on a sturdy raised surface such as a table or sofa edge. Lower your chest to the edge and press back up with a straight body.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Diamond Push-ups
items.instructions: Hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond. Lower with elbows tucked, then press up.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Wide Push-ups
items.instructions: Place your hands wider than your shoulders. Lower your chest between your hands and press up, keeping your body straight.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Chair Triceps Dips
items.instructions: Hands on the edge of a stable chair behind you, legs out in front. Bend your elbows to lower your hips, then press back up. Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Superman Hold
items.instructions: Lie face down with arms extended. Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor, pause, and lower. Look at the floor to keep your neck neutral.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
items.instructions: Rest the top of one foot on a chair behind you. Lower your back knee towards the floor, then push up through the front heel. Count reps for ONE leg.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Jump Squats
items.instructions: Squat down, then jump up explosively and land softly with bent knees, going straight into the next rep.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Sumo Squats
items.instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out. Lower straight down keeping your knees over your toes, then stand and squeeze your glutes.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Step-ups
items.instructions: Step onto a sturdy step or low bench with one foot, stand fully, then step down with control. Count reps for ONE leg.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Side Lunges
items.instructions: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip keeping the other leg straight, then push back to the centre. Count reps for ONE side.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Forward Lunges
items.instructions: Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, then push back to standing. Count reps for ONE leg.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Single-leg Glute Bridges
items.instructions: Glute bridge position with one leg extended. Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips, keeping them level, then lower. Count reps for ONE leg.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Donkey Kicks
items.instructions: On hands and knees, press one heel up towards the ceiling with your knee bent, squeeze the glute, lower. Keep your back flat. Count reps for ONE leg.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Backpack Shoulder Press
items.instructions: Hold a loaded backpack at chest height by the top handle or straps. Press it overhead until your arms are straight, and lower with control.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Lateral Raises
items.instructions: Stand with a light weight in each hand. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with soft elbows and lower slowly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Hammer Curls
items.instructions: Hold weights with palms facing each other. Curl up keeping your elbows by your sides, and lower with control.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Pull-ups
items.instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip. Pull your chest towards the bar by driving your elbows down, then lower fully under control.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Crunches
items.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Curl your shoulders off the floor using your abs, without pulling on your neck, then lower.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Bicycle Crunches
items.instructions: Lie on your back, hands by your head. Bring opposite elbow and knee together while the other leg extends, and alternate in a pedalling motion. Count every twist as one rep.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Russian Twists
items.instructions: Sit with knees bent and torso leaning back slightly. Rotate your shoulders from side to side, touching the floor beside each hip. Count every side as one rep.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Leg Raises
items.instructions: Lie flat with legs straight. Raise them to vertical, then lower slowly without letting your lower back arch off the floor.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Mountain Climbers
items.instructions: In a high plank, drive one knee towards your chest then switch legs quickly. Keep your hips level. Count every knee drive as one rep.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Side Plank
items.instructions: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder. Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line and hold. Time ONE side; the app counts both sides.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.instructions: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg until they are level with your back, pause, and return. Count reps for ONE side.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Flutter Kicks
items.instructions: Lie on your back with legs just off the floor and press your lower back down. Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating movements. Count every kick as one rep.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Jumping Jacks
items.instructions: Jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead, then jump back to standing. Land softly.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Burpees
items.instructions: From standing, squat and place your hands down, jump or step your feet back to a plank, return your feet, then jump up with your arms overhead.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: High Knees
items.instructions: Run on the spot, driving your knees up towards hip height and pumping your arms.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Skipping Rope
items.instructions: Turn the rope with your wrists and jump low, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Cycling
items.instructions: Cycle at a steady, moderate effort where your breathing is deeper but controlled.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Swimming
items.instructions: Swim continuous laps at an easy to moderate pace, resting as needed.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Stair Climbing
items.instructions: Climb stairs at a steady pace, using the whole foot on each step and keeping your chest up.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Easy Walk
items.instructions: Walk at a relaxed pace you could keep up for a long time.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Downward Dog
items.instructions: From hands and knees, lift your hips up and back so your body forms an upside-down V. Press your heels towards the floor and relax your neck.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Cobra Pose
items.instructions: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press gently to lift your chest while keeping your hips down and shoulders relaxed.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Warrior II Pose
items.instructions: Stand with feet wide, front knee bent over the ankle, arms extended parallel to the floor. Hold and breathe. Time ONE side; the app counts both sides.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Hamstring Stretch
items.instructions: Sit or stand and extend one leg, hinging forward from the hips with a long back until you feel a gentle stretch behind your thigh. Time ONE side.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
items.instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward. Tuck your pelvis and shift forward gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip. Time ONE side.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.

items.name: Arm Circles
items.instructions: Stand tall with arms extended to the sides and make small, controlled circles, then reverse the direction.
items.notes: Calorie value is a rough estimate for a 70 kg adult and scales with your body weight.
